memories.content: The session implemented and verified several runtime hardening changes around freshness, reroutes, and durability. Key changes included introducing a reusable wave-index lookup in the DAG runtime, adding a path-resolution token helper in the MS Graph adapter, pinning prompt-bootstrap failure behavior, and expanding freshness index tests to cover logical-write acknowledgements after later writes. Tests were run successfully for host runtime capabilities, MS Graph path resolution, human/reroute resolution, customer-summary prompts/server, and the framework freshness/file boundary suites.
memories.summary: Implemented and verified multiple durability/freshness hardening changes across the runtime and adapters.

memories.content: The freshness index now has an explicit logical-write acknowledgement check (`hasRecordedWrite`) that should remain true even after a later write becomes the latest singleton. This was added to both in-memory and file-backed freshness index test coverage, and Redis member ordering tests now include a numeric epoch boundary case (epoch 10 vs 9) plus a property asserting byte-order alignment with numeric execution-epoch order.
memories.summary: Freshness acknowledgements are now tested to survive later superseding writes, with stronger ordering coverage.

memories.content: The DAG runtime was refactored to share a canonical node-to-wave index helper (`waveIndexByNodeId`) from wave-resolution logic, and reroute/human-resolution now use that helper instead of rebuilding wave maps inline. This reduces duplicated indexing logic and centralizes wave lookup behavior.
memories.summary: Wave lookup logic was centralized into a reusable helper and adopted by reroute/human-resolution flows.

memories.content: SharePoint path resolution in the MS Graph adapter was hardened by adding a dedicated token-acquisition helper that returns a typed transient error when access token retrieval fails or returns an empty token. The request path now uses the helper before issuing Graph calls, preserving the Result boundary around token failures.
memories.summary: MS Graph path resolution now fails closed on token acquisition problems via a typed helper.

memories.content: Customer-summary bootstrap prompt loading remains a critical fail-fast boundary: synthesis and synthesis-system prompt failures must reject bootstrap loudly, while summary-eval-rubric can degrade with a warning. The test file was edited to keep this contract pinned in place.
memories.summary: Bootstrap prompt loading keeps the fatal-vs-best-effort split pinned by tests.

memories.content: Freshness emission now fails closed when logical-write acknowledgement lookup fails. A new test was added to verify that if `freshnessIndex.hasRecordedWrite` errors, the wave aborts without emitting witness or violation events.
memories.summary: Logical-write acknowledgement failures abort freshness emission without side effects.

memories.content: The file-backed freshness index preserves earlier logical-write acknowledgements after later writes supersede the singleton. The new test restarts the file index from disk and verifies that the earlier write identity still returns true while an unrelated identity returns false.
memories.summary: File freshness state now preserves earlier write acknowledgements across restarts and later superseding writes.
